states.name: Arsenal
states.title: Scion of the Labyrinth
states.description: Once upon a time, she was simply "Al", a young girl who spent her days playing with her friends until sunset. But on the day she inherited the name "Arsenal" and her family's sworn mission from her grandfather, her future was sealed away within the ruins. That was the "curse" passed down to her.

states.name: Arsenal
states.title: Scion of the Labyrinth
states.description: Whenever a challenger arrived, Arsenal eagerly struck up a conversation with them. After all, to a girl alone in the labyrinth, every visitor was a precious chance for companionship. But those happy moments never lasted. In the end, every challenger was reduced to a corpse one way or another, leaving her alone in the labyrinth once more.

states.name: Arsenal
states.title: Scion of the Labyrinth
states.description:
When Arsenal faced the former queen and the silent knight, she realized that this would be her end. Yet strangely, she felt no fear. Her long mission was finally over—or so she believed.

But what awaited her was not the end of her life, but the end of an isolation that had lasted far too long.
